title: prefill/decode: chunked speculative prefill, stage-overlap, kernel scheduler and KV-cache improvements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Prefill work has been a major source of latency/throughput variance for long-context workloads. This PR brings together several runtime improvements to reduce end-to-end prefill and decode tail latency and improve throughput: 1) chunked prefill: break long prefill requests into fixed-size chunks for better kernel utilization and memory locality; 2) speculative prefill: issue speculative next-chunk prefetches to overlap prefill and decode stages when tokens are still being generated; 3) stage-overlap pipeline: formalize prefill->decode overlap in the pipeline with explicit handoff points and backpressure signals; 4) kernel scheduler: introduce a lightweight kernel scheduler that prioritizes small, latency-sensitive decode work while packing prefill chunks for throughput; 5) KV-cache ergonomics: asynchronous cache population and per-request KV cache warming to reduce cache-miss stalls; 6) continuous batching: tweaks to continuous batching heuristics to better coalesce speculative-prefill chunks without violating latency SLOs. Changes: - runtime/pipeline/prefill_manager.rs: chunking logic, speculative prefetch state machine, metrics. - runtime/scheduler/kernel_scheduler.rs: new scheduler implementation (policy: latency-first small tasks, throughput packing for chunked prefill). - runtime/kv_cache/cache_manager.rs: async warming, eviction tuning for chunked access patterns. - runtime/batching/continuous_batcher.rs: heuristic adjustments (idle-wait thresholds, dynamic batch caps). - bench/perf/prefill_decode/throughput.yaml: benchmark harness and new workloads. - docs/perf/prefill-decode.md: design notes and migration guidance. Compatibility: default behavior unchanged unless feature flags are enabled. Flags: --prefill-chunk-size, --enable-speculative-prefill, --kernel-scheduler=on/off, --kv-warmup=on/off. Testing & validation: unit tests for state machine and scheduler policies; integration perf CI runs across A100/GPU clusters; localized latency-sensitive smoke tests. Benchmarks: end-to-end throughput improved by ~18% on mixed-long-context workloads; p50 prefill+decode latency reduced 12%, p95 reduced 20% in our canary cluster. Checklist: - [x] Design doc and Linear links included - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration perf job passing - [x] Documentation updates - [x] Feature flags behind rollout gate Rollout plan: feature gated; gradual canary on Dedicated then Hosted; 2-week perf monitoring window with automatic rollback on >5% regression on cost or >10% regression on latency SLOs.
